title: DL560 authenticated observer lookup cannot read B79D native run identity after reconnect
outcome: Identify why ObserveTestRun fails for the original DL560 registration after reconnect, and preserve authenticated origin-identity and terminal-custody checks when fixing or reporting the identified refusal.
acceptance: The authenticated DL560 observer failure is traced to the original failing boundary, or a supported bounded diagnostic distinguishes authority mismatch, transport/timeout, semantic reply refusal and unavailable durable registration without exposing sensitive details.

A behavior test exercises the diagnosed path with a valid original registration and absent native terminal, proving identity is observable when authority and durable readback hold and no terminal or credit is inferred, with existing reconnect and identity-conflict guards preserved.
